items.title: Mau import local cho cong cu crawler
items.excerpt: Ban ghi mau de test import tu file JSON local.
items.content_html:
Mau import local cho cong cu crawler

Day la noi dung HTML mau dung de kiem tra pipeline import local vao bang imported_contents.

Noi dung nay khong duoc publish tu dong va can admin kiem tra truoc khi convert.
